definitions.oracle_status: Complete test source judgment independent of native result.
definitions.combination_increment: yes means a supported test distinguishes a previously unchecked interaction; existing-combination oracle strengthening is retained separately, not silently counted as a new input interaction. unknown preserves a intended interaction with an unsupported complete oracle.
definitions.substantive_observation_increment: An additional discriminating observation can be useful even when the input combination already has coverage.
definitions.primary_target_hit: The predeclared scoped interaction is actually tested with its supported oracle; unrelated passing tests and unrelated defects do not qualify.

rows.reason: The initial classification excluded this as an ordinary input boundary too broadly. The meaningful relation is BOM allowance × first-nonblank-record state. Original tests cover a first-record BOM and multiple ordinary records. The new later-record BOM distinguishes an erroneous implementation that strips BOM on every record, while those original tests and the malformed-text test would still pass. This classification follows source semantics, not native behavior.
